cohort: 100 children aged 6-12 years diagnosed with MIH and 100 age-matched children without MIH
finding: Cesarean section delivery and a history of sixth disease (roseola) were significantly associated with an increased likelihood of developing molar incisor hypomineralization (MIH) in children.
mod_finding: Cesarean-section delivery was found to be significantly associated with an increased likelihood of developing molar incisor hypomineralization (MIH).
